values.note: Sarasota County, rates effective October 2024: $75 a night; 10% off stays of 21-30 nights. 13% tax and a non-refundable 2.45% electronic payment surcharge added at checkout. Changes and cancellations that earn a refund cost $25; inside 48 hours, one night.

values.note: Portable restrooms and shower trailers. Free Wi-Fi and cable TV, 'not guaranteed'. Camp host on site.

values.note: Booked online through Sarasota County's WebTrac up to one year ahead (a separate link for a start date exactly 365 days out). Holiday and event weekends (Fall Fest, Veterans Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas, New Year) book by phone only. Closed for maintenance Sept 14-17, 2026 and Sept 12-16, 2027. Arriving after 1 p.m. the day after your arrival date without notice is a no-show.

booking.source: https://www.sarasotacountyparks.com/parks-and-facilities/discover-a-park/destination-parks/turtle-beach-campground ('BOOKING ONE YEAR IN ADVANCE ... only for booking reservations with a start date exactly 365 days in advance', 'Online Reservation Restrictions', 'Closures'), read 2026-10-21

note: Sarasota County beachfront campground on Siesta Key (8862 Midnight Pass Rd). Crushed-shell pads, cable TV. Direct Turtle Beach (Gulf) access; kayak launch on Blackburn Bay side. No pets (service animals only), no campfires, up to six guests per site. Free trolley to Siesta Beach, Siesta Village and downtown Sarasota. --Claude
summary: County page confirms $75/night (Oct 2024 rates), full hookups 20/30/50 A, 39 sites, Wi-Fi; added showers, 365-day booking window, phone-only holiday weekends and the September maintenance closures. Not stated: max rig length (38 ft from the note left).
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: the county page calls it 'Sarasota County's premier beachfront campground' with 'direct beach access' ('one of only a few campgrounds in Florida with direct beach access'); the entry is 'not waterfront'.
